title: 氣密封裝與漏率檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入腔體漏率、滲透與細漏/粗漏；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine cavity leakage, permeation and fine/gross leak tests. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。氦等效漏率不能不經轉換就當成實際空氣或水汽漏率；測試門檻須依腔體容積、氣體及用途設定。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Helium-equivalent leak rates are not automatically air or moisture leak rates; limits depend on cavity volume, gas and application.
